title: DBSP: Automatic Incremental View Maintenance for Rich Query Languages
by: Mihai Budiu, Tej Chajed, Frank McSherry, Leonid Ryzhyk and Val Tannen (VMware Research, Materialize, University of Pennsylvania), PVLDB 16(7)
summary: The paper behind Feldera, and a VLDB 2023 Best Paper. It models a database as a stream of snapshots and its transactions as a stream of changes, defines the incremental version of any query as differentiate ∘ query ∘ integrate, and shows how a chain rule, linear and bilinear operators and Z-sets (rows with signed weights) turn that into an efficient, syntax-directed algorithm for SQL, nested relations, aggregation and recursive queries. Every theorem is checked in Lean. Dense with notation, but the introduction and sections 2 to 4 are readable on their own.
